content: We need count of methyl groups in the molecule. But we have no description of molecule. Possibly the system expects we retrieve NMR spectra and infer methyl groups? But we don't have SMILES. Maybe the sample is implicit? Could be previous tasks? Not given. Could use carbon NMR to count methyl signals (around 10-30 ppm). But need molecule. Could be we need to ask for data? However we have no tool to get molecule description. The only tools are NMR predictions, but they need sample at hand. The environment likely has a sample loaded. We can call carbon_nmr_spectra to get 13C NMR, then count methyl carbon signals (around 10-30 ppm). Let's do that.
